description: A reproducible R workflow that audits stability across defensible omics analysis variants. It installs microbiomeAudit 0.4.0, validates a standard CSV input, computes direction and significance consistency, assigns robustness classes, and generates an HTML report, result table, manifest and figure. Example data and automated tests are included. This workflow supports the manuscript "Gut microbiota and type 2 diabetes: causal and predictive claims are not demonstrably robust in a preregistered evidence audit."
name: microbiomeAudit evidence-audit workflow
